correctness.rationale: The printed uncontrolled Jacobian has constant trace \(c-a-b\), so Liouville fixes the finite-time determinant growth and hence the sum of finite-time singular-value growth rates; any asymptotic Lyapunov spectrum must have the same sum. At \(a=40,b=2,c=22\) the exact sum is \(-20\). Exact decimal addition reproduces source sums \(20.5159,22.3152,24.3169\). Adding diagonal feedback shifts the trace by \(r_1+r_2+r_3+r_4\), giving required sums \(-120\) and \(-140\), versus the printed \(-62.6296\) and \(-82.0194\). The finite QR replay is supporting evidence only.
risks: The contradiction invalidates only the five quoted exponent vectors; it does not prove absence of hyperchaos or failure of stabilization.
